message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Cao, logistics department head, colluded with truck drivers and transport companies to have them issue false invoices (增值税专用发票) for tax deduction. He took a percentage of the invoice amount as fee. He then submitted these invoices to his company for accounting, and the company used 117 groups of invoices (total 2,895,173 yuan) to deduct tax amount 202,662.11 yuan from tax authority.

Thus the crime is "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" (i.e., false issuance of VAT special invoices for tax deduction). The list includes a label: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". That matches.

Also possibly "经济犯" (economic crime) but the specific label is the above. In examples, they used that label for similar case (the Wu1 case). So answer should be that single label.

Check if any other charges: maybe "受贿" or "行贿"? He is not receiving bribes, but he is facilitating false invoices for a fee. That's false invoicing. So only that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票<eoa>
